info.name: BOBJ Raylight REST API - LCMBIAR CI/CD
info.description:
# SAP BusinessObjects Raylight REST API Collection

Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the SAP BOBJ Raylight REST API endpoints used in the LCMBIAR CI/CD pipeline.

## How to Import This Collection

1. Open Postman and click **Import** (top-left button or Ctrl+O / Cmd+O)
2. Choose one of these methods:
   - **File**: Click "Upload Files" and select `BOBJ-Raylight-API.postman_collection.json`
   - **Folder**: Select the entire `postman/` folder to import both the collection and environment
   - **Drag & Drop**: Drag the JSON file directly into the Postman window
3. Also import the environment file: `BOBJ-Raylight-API.postman_environment.json`
4. Select the imported environment from the top-right environment dropdown
5. Edit the environment variables (click the eye icon) and set your server URL, credentials, etc.

## How to Export This Collection

1. In Postman, right-click the collection name in the sidebar
2. Click **Export**
3. Choose **Collection v2.1** format
4. Save to `postman/BOBJ-Raylight-API.postman_collection.json` in the repo
5. To export the environment: click the gear icon next to the environment dropdown → select the environment → click **Export** → save as `postman/BOBJ-Raylight-API.postman_environment.json`

## Endpoints Covered (21 total)

| Category | Count | Endpoints |
|----------|-------|-----------|
| Authentication | 2 | Logon, Logoff |
| Health & Info | 2 | Base connectivity, Raylight About |
| Raylight Documents | 3 | List, Get by ID, Get Schedules |
| InfoStore / CMS | 6 | Folder resolve, CUID lookup, Children, Object by CUID/SI_ID |
| Promotion / LCM | 8 | Create, Status, Test, Promote, Execute, Results, Download LCMBIAR |

## Typical Workflow

### Export LCMBIAR (CI Pipeline)
1. **Authenticate** → `POST /biprws/logon/long` → get logon token
2. **Health Check** → `GET /biprws/raylight/v1/about` → verify server
3. **Resolve Folder** → `GET /biprws/infostore/folder?path=...` → get folder ID
4. **Create Promotion Job** → `POST /biprws/promotion/` → get job ID
5. **Execute Job** → `POST /biprws/promotion/{id}/execute`
6. **Poll Status** → `GET /biprws/promotion/{id}` → wait for completion
7. **Download LCMBIAR** → `GET /biprws/promotion/{id}/lcmbiar` → save file
8. **Logoff** → `POST /biprws/logoff`

### Import LCMBIAR (CD Pipeline)
1. **Authenticate** → `POST /biprws/logon/long`
2. **Health Check** → `GET /biprws/raylight/v1/about`
3. **Upload LCMBIAR** → `POST /biprws/promotion/` (multipart form-data)
4. **Poll Status** → `GET /biprws/promotion/{id}`
5. **Get Results** → `GET /biprws/promotion/{id}/results`
6. **Logoff** → `POST /biprws/logoff`

## Authentication

All requests (except logon) require the `X-SAP-LogonToken` header. The collection uses a collection-level pre-request script that auto-sets this header from the `logonToken` environment variable. Run the **Logon** request first to populate it.

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `baseUrl` | BOBJ server base URL | `https://bobj-dev.example.com:8080` |
| `username` | BOBJ username | `Administrator` |
| `password` | BOBJ password | `yourPassword` |
| `authType` | Auth type | `secEnterprise` |
| `logonToken` | Auto-set after logon | (auto) |
| `folderId` | Folder ID for export | (auto or manual) |
| `promotionJobId` | Promotion job ID | (auto) |
| `documentId` | Document SI_ID for testing | `12345` |
| `objectCuid` | Object CUID for testing | `AX.example123` |

exec: // Auto-set X-SAP-LogonToken header for all requests except logon
console.warn('No logonToken set. Run the Logon request first.');

item.name: 1. Authentication & Session
item.description: Endpoints for session lifecycle management. Always start with Logon and end with Logoff.

body.raw:
<attrs xmlns="http://www.sap.com/rws/bip">
  <attr name="userName" type="string">{{username}}</attr>
  <attr name="password" type="string">{{password}}</attr>
  <attr name="auth" type="string" possibilities="secEnterprise,secLDAP,secWinAD,secSAPR3">{{authType}}</attr>
</attrs>

request.description:
Authenticates to SAP BusinessObjects and returns a session logon token.

The token is automatically saved to the `logonToken` environment variable and used by all subsequent requests via the `X-SAP-LogonToken` header.

**Token lifetime**: ~60 minutes (refresh before expiry).

body.raw:
<attrs xmlns="http://www.sap.com/rws/bip">
  <attr name="userName" type="string">Administrator</attr>
  <attr name="password" type="string">P@ssw0rd</attr>
  <attr name="auth" type="string" possibilities="secEnterprise,secLDAP,secWinAD,secSAPR3">secEnterprise</attr>
</attrs>

response.name: Error - Invalid Credentials

body.raw:
<attrs xmlns="http://www.sap.com/rws/bip">
  <attr name="userName" type="string">wronguser</attr>
  <attr name="password" type="string">wrongpass</attr>
  <attr name="auth" type="string">secEnterprise</attr>
</attrs>

request.description:
Invalidates the current session token and closes the server-side session.

Always call this when done to free server resources. The test script auto-clears the `logonToken` environment variable.

item.name: 5. Promotion / LCM (Export Flow)
item.description:
Endpoints for the LCMBIAR export workflow: create promotion job → execute → poll → download.

**Run these in order:**
1. Create Promotion Job
2. Execute Promotion
3. Get Promotion Status (poll until Completed)
4. Download LCMBIAR

request.description:
Creates a new promotion export job. The job is created in a pending state - call Execute or Promote to start it.

The test script auto-saves the `promotionJobId` to the environment.

response.name: Error - Invalid Source

request.description: Runs a dry-run test of the promotion job without actually exporting. Returns a list of objects that would be included and any potential conflicts. Use this to validate before executing.

Starts execution of the promotion job. The job runs asynchronously - poll the status endpoint until completion.

Alternative endpoint: `POST /biprws/promotion/{id}/promote`
Alternative endpoint to execute the promotion job. Functionally equivalent to `/execute`.

exec: console.log('Job completed! Proceed to download LCMBIAR.');
console.log('Still running... send this request again to poll.');

request.description:
Polls the promotion job status. Keep calling until `status` is `Completed`, `Success`, or `Failed`.

**Possible states**: Pending, Running, InProgress, Completed, Success, Failed, Error, Cancelled

**Recommended poll interval**: 5 seconds

request.description: Retrieves detailed results after a promotion job completes. Shows each object processed, success/failure status, and any warnings.

response.name: Success - Export Results

request.description:
Downloads the LCMBIAR archive file from a completed promotion job.

**Tip**: In Postman, click "Save Response" → "Save to a file" to save the `.lcmbiar` file to disk.

The response is a binary file (application/octet-stream).

item.name: 6. Promotion / LCM (Import Flow)
item.description:
Endpoints for the LCMBIAR import workflow: upload LCMBIAR → poll → verify results.

**Run these in order:**
1. Upload LCMBIAR (Import)
2. Get Promotion Status (poll until Completed)
3. Get Promotion Results (verify)

formdata.description: Conflict resolution: overwrite, skip, rename, fail

request.description:
Uploads an LCMBIAR archive for import/promotion into the target BOBJ environment.

**Steps to use:**
1. In the Body tab, click "Select Files" next to the `file` field
2. Browse to your `.lcmbiar` file
3. Set conflict resolution: `overwrite` (update existing), `skip`, `rename`, or `fail`
4. Send the request
5. Poll the returned job ID for completion

**Conflict Resolution Options:**
- `overwrite` – Update existing objects (most common for CI/CD)
- `skip` – Skip objects that already exist
- `rename` – Import with a new name if conflict
- `fail` – Abort if any conflict is found

response.name: Error - Invalid File

request.description:
Polls the import job status. Same endpoint as export status polling.

Poll every 5 seconds until `status` is `Completed` or `Failed`.
Retrieves detailed results after an import completes. Shows per-object status, conflicts resolved, and any errors.
